<!-- pr-reviewer: 6453e9b36c895d261be50237885617d292a05b40 -->
Needs changes before merge. This is a safety-tier review, because the PR changes toolpath plans and carries moved NC goldens.

**What looks good**

- `pocket_avoid` and `machining3d::hsm::plan_level` now use the same Zigzag plan as the plain 2D pocket (`rest_passes`). Each level closes with one ring on each boundary loop.
- The rotary wrap keeps its rows. The decision record gives the reason and names #3168 as the follow-up.
- The 5 new pins measure the wall scallop at each level and check `verify::crossed_pairs`. The two mutations below show that each pin set holds its own call site.
- The new code has no `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` outside tests. `rest_passes` propagates its errors with `?`.
- No file grows past 400 lines (`pocket.rs` 394, `hsm.rs` 368). The new test file is in `camcraft-motion`, the lowest crate that it imports. Its gate map names that crate.
- This PR adds no golden change of its own. The 16 NC and CL goldens and the 2 sample programs are identical to the head of #3130 (`6e3e4397b`). The review of #3130 compared those goldens line by line. I did not compare them again.

**Results, merged with main (locally)**

Trial merge of `6453e9b36` with upstream/main `f036dddad`, in `.claude/worktrees/review-3167`. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only "motion suites"`: 74 steps, 71 passed, 3 failed (1,066 tests passed, 4 failed). The failures are in finding 1.
- Selected app and post steps (`--only`, 18 steps): 18 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- I did not run the other 656 app steps of the quick plan. The author reports them in the PR body.

**Extra suites run**

The changed goldens are `crates/app/tests/golden/` and `examples/`. I ran these readers by name:

| Crate | Suite | Result |
|---|---|---|
| app | `golden_cl` | 33 passed |
| app | `conformance` | 7 passed |
| app | `solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |
| app | `first_part_programs` | 2 passed |
| app | `example_catalog` | 33 passed, 2 ignored |
| app | `recorded_post_streams` | 5 passed |
| cl | `headless_bin` | 3 passed |
| post | `post_engine` | 33 passed |
| post | `explain_tormach` | 3 passed |
| post | `heidenhain_block_form` | 5 passed |
| post | `recorded_streams` | 12 passed |

Other suites for the changed code: app `operations` 121 passed (6 ignored), `setup_align` 10, `blind_floor` 8, `do_not_touch` 3, `do_not_touch_project` 3, `rotary_verify` 9, `rotary_fixtures` 4, `rotary_field_parity` 3 (6 ignored). Motion `pocket_wall_finish_levels` 5, `pocket_wall_finish` 5, `pocket3d_hsm`, `machining3d`, `multiaxis_rough` and `offset_shells` passed in the motion run.

No STEP fixture and no importer code changes. The importer add-on does not apply.

**Heavy lanes**

Not run, by the author or by this review. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects 236 steps in motion and app. "Not run" is not a pass. See finding 2.

**Mutation checks**

1. Disable the new Zigzag branch in `pocket_avoid.rs`: the 3 avoid pins fail (outer wall scallop 0.755 mm, 0.919 mm with blended turns). The 2 3D pins pass.
2. Disable the early return in `hsm.rs::plan_level`: the 2 3D pins fail (boss wall scallop 2.000 mm at level Z -5). The 3 avoid pins pass.
3. Restore both: 5 of 5 pass. The worktree has no source change after the restore.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs:321` - Four motion tests fail on the trial merge:
   - `center_cut_law::a_tool_that_is_not_centre_cutting_never_plunges_into_a_pocket_between_passes`
   - `level_links::keep_down_pass_links_stay_at_depth_where_proved_and_say_where_not`
   - `machining2d::zigzag_fills_a_square_with_one_plunge_per_level`
   - `machining2d::zigzag_hops_over_islands_and_leaves_them_standing`

   All four pass on plain upstream/main `f036dddad`. All four also fail on the head of #3130 (`6e3e4397b`) alone, and on #3130 merged with main. The cause is in the stacked commits of #3130 that this PR carries (the plain pocket now takes `rest_passes` and the crossing hold for each Zigzag pocket). The PR body says that "this PR does not cause" them. That is not correct for a merge of this branch into main.

   The `center_cut_law` failure is a crossing-law failure, not only a count:
   ```
   left: [Crossing { moves: [291, 319] }, Crossing { moves: [291, 607] }, Crossing { moves: [296, 320] }, Crossing { moves: [296, 608] }, Crossing { moves: [581, 609] }, Crossing { moves: [586, 610] }]
   right: []
   ```
   The other three tests count entry dives and kept-down links (`one entry dive at every level`: left 4, right 2; island hops: left 14, right 8; `keep-down found nothing to keep`).

   Fix the crossing pairs in #3130 (or on this branch). For the count tests, either keep the old counts or change each assertion with a reason in the decision record. Then run these three suites again on the final head.

2. `crates/motion/src/machining3d/hsm.rs:138` - Run the reached heavy lanes on the final head: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. Record the lanes and their results in the PR body. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, **Heavy lanes at review**, makes this a readiness condition. The PR body says that the heavy lanes did not run.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- The review of #3130 reported zero failures on its head. On this machine, the 3 motion suites above fail on `6e3e4397b` without main. #3130 needs the same fix before it merges.
- There is no UI change. Before/after screenshots do not apply.
- The PR stays a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. The restart checks the candidate entry against prior feed moves. A crossing helix takes a checked ramp instead.
   Evidence: `center_cut_law::a_closing_ring_restart_does_not_cross_the_rows_transition_ramp` and the pocket matrix test pass.
   The square and island pins now describe their closing rings. The KeepDown pin measures the rapid moves that planar links avoid.
   Evidence: `machining2d::zigzag_fills_a_square_with_rows_and_a_closing_ring_per_level`, `machining2d::zigzag_hops_over_islands_and_leaves_them_standing`, and `level_links::keep_down_pass_links_stay_at_depth_where_proved_and_say_where_not` pass.
   All three mutations give RED. Restoring the changes gives GREEN. Five focused suites pass all 97 tests.
2. The reached motion and app heavy lanes pass. All 235 steps pass in 37.4 minutes.
   The lanes pass 100 ordinary tests. The gate accepts six expected failures for #1950 and #2849. The PR body lists the lanes.

Quick gate: GREEN, 735 steps, zero failures. Clippy on motion and app: GREEN.
New head: `1d1fd8b7204f05e3e69d46dce55922d2ec5a172b`.

Please re-review this head.
